To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
LSD1 and the EDS1-mediated defence signalling pathways are antagonistic regulators that differentially control UV-C-induced photo-oxidative stress signalling leading to PCD in A. thaliana.
LSD1 and AtBI1 are antagonistic regulators that differentially modulate UV-C-induced PCD in Arabidopsis.
LSD1 and the EDS1-mediated signalling pathway differentially regulate UV radiation-induced photooxidative damage and PCD in Arabidopsis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of new regulators of UV-induced cell death and the elucidation of their molecular mechanisms.
the elucidation of molecular mechanisms underlying the regulation of UV-C-induced cell death in plants.
the molecular mechanisms of PCD development and the regulation of the plant cell life cycle.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
LSD1 and AtEDS1 act antagonistically to regulate PCD in response of UV-C stress.
the UV-C-triggered signalling pathways are highly interconnected and are regulated by a complex network of genes and proteins.
LSD1 and AtBI1 are positive regulators of UV-C-triggered PCD, whereas EDS1 is a negative regulator of UV-induced PCD.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
LSD1 and its downstream target AtBI1 are required for the maintenance of UV-C-induced cell death in Arabdopsis thaliana.
LSD1 and/or EDS1 regulate UV-C-induced cell death through their effects on the photosynthetic electron transport chain and the production of reactive oxygen species.
the antagonistic LSD1-EDS1 signalling pathway plays a crucial role in regulating UV-C-induced PCD in Arabidopsis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
LSD1 and its interacting partner EDS1 differentially regulate photooxidative stress signal transduction and PCD in response UV-C in A. thaliana.
LSD1 and AtBI1 act as antagonistic regulators of plant PCD in response not only to biotic but also to abiotic stresses.
UV-C-induced PCD in Arabidopsis is an active process that is tightly controlled by the LSD1-EDS1 regulatory module.
